sections.Profile:
The "Hollywood" pinball machine, released by Williams Electronic Manufacturing Company in May 1961, is a two-player electro-mechanical game designed by Steve Kordek, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1961
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Women, Hollywood, Arts & Entertainment, Original Theme, Movie
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Steve Kordek
- Art: George Molentin
